tracks.interview: Two models differ by three points on a noisy suite. What information is missing before recommending a release?
tracks.evidence: A benchmark with a task specification, multiple trials, grader validation, error slices and an actual release recommendation.

tracks.name: AI security engineer
tracks.name_ja: AI セキュリティエンジニア

tracks.evidence: A threat model whose attacks map to implemented controls, meaningful tests and clearly documented residual failures.

tracks.name: Responsible AI and governance engineer
tracks.name_ja: 責任ある AI・ガバナンスエンジニア

milestones.text: Inventory a use case, affected people, data flows, risks and accountable owners.

milestones.text: Attach tests and evidence to each control; make the remaining uncertainty explicit.
milestones.text_ja: 各統制にテストと証跡を結び付け、残る不確かさを明示する。

milestones.text: Review operation and changes, rehearse an incident and support a real approval decision.
milestones.text_ja: 運用と変更をレビューし、インシデントを予行演習し、実際の承認判断を支える。

tracks.evidence: A traceable risk-to-control-to-test evidence pack, plus an example where governance changed a design or deployment decision.

tracks.name: Model adaptation and post-training engineer

tracks.name: Research engineer
tracks.name_ja: リサーチエンジニア

milestones.text_ja: 公開された小さな手法を再現し、報告された設定との食い違いを解消する。

milestones.text: Investigate an unexplained result and write a technical report that can be independently checked.

tracks.evidence: Reproducible experiments, an explained implementation and evidence you can independently debug ambiguous training or measurement failures.

tracks.name_ja: リサーチサイエンティスト

milestones.text: Obtain substantive external review and build a sustained record through papers, collaborations or equivalent recognized work.

tracks.name: Edge and embedded AI engineer

milestones.text: Measure sustained thermal behavior and complete a repeatable device deployment and update process.
milestones.text_ja: 持続的な発熱挙動を測り、再現可能なデバイスへの配備と更新の手順を完成させる。

milestones.text: Write a product bet with acceptance, risk, adoption and commercial hypotheses.

milestones.text: Launch a narrow version and measure activation, retained use and willingness to pay.

milestones.text: Choose the next investment using user evidence, unit economics and a clear stop/continue decision.
milestones.text_ja: 利用者の根拠、ユニットエコノミクス、明確な継続・中止判断で次の投資を選ぶ。

tracks.interview: Choose between improving accuracy, onboarding or pricing using incomplete evidence.

tracks.name: AI developer advocate / developer relations
tracks.name_ja: AI デベロッパーアドボケイト／デベロッパーリレーションズ

milestones.text: Publish one tutorial that a fresh user can reproduce and explain where it fails.
milestones.text_ja: 新しい利用者が再現できるチュートリアルを一つ公開し、どこでつまずくかを説明する。

milestones.text: Deliver a workshop or technical talk and collect questions and onboarding friction.

milestones.text: Contribute a product/SDK fix from that feedback and maintain examples across releases.

milestones.text: Verify controls in a local authorized test environment.

capstones.name_ja: 開発者向けプロダクトの普及と経済性
capstones.question: Do target users repeatedly use this product, and what changes improve adoption?

capstones.name: Reproducible service infrastructure
capstones.name_ja: 再現可能なサービスインフラ
capstones.question: Can a service be deployed, diagnosed, changed and restored under explicit operating constraints?

capstones.name: Security assurance and incident lab
capstones.name_ja: セキュリティ保証とインシデントのラボ
capstones.question: Do selected controls and detections reduce a defined risk under tested conditions?

capstones.name: Procurement data and analytics platform
capstones.name_ja: 調達データと分析の基盤
capstones.question: Can spend/operational data stay correct and useful after correction, change and recovery?

capstones.name: Maintainable application and verification
capstones.name_ja: 保守しやすいアプリケーションと検証
capstones.question: Can a user/device workflow remain correct through realistic state, resource and release changes?

capstones.name: Enterprise workflow and technical delivery
capstones.name_ja: エンタープライズの業務フローと技術デリバリー
capstones.question: Can multiple systems/teams deliver an accepted business outcome with recoverable exceptions?

routes.name: Staff / principal engineer
routes.name_ja: スタッフ／プリンシパルエンジニア
routes.about: Scope overlay for any engineering specialization. Multiply the effectiveness of several teams through architecture, shared systems, technical strategy and difficult tradeoffs; retain depth in a chosen specialty.

routes.name: AI engineering manager
routes.name_ja: AI エンジニアリングマネージャー
routes.about: People and execution route. Build a capable team, coach performance, hire, allocate work and deliver through others. Technical leads may not yet have these people-management duties.

routes.name: CTO / CAIO / head of AI
routes.about: Executive route; responsibilities vary by organization. CTO often owns the technology organization and execution; CAIO may own AI strategy, portfolio, governance and adoption. Budget, leadership and enterprise outcomes outweigh tool familiarity.

routes.name: AI founder / independent product builder
routes.name_ja: AI 創業者／個人プロダクト開発者
routes.about: Commercial route. Find a repeatable customer problem, build a product, sell it, retain users and sustain the business. Model novelty is optional; customer value is essential.

routes.name: Security leadership / CISO route
routes.name_ja: セキュリティリーダー／CISO
routes.about: Own a proportionate security strategy, risk decisions, operating capability, budgets and executive communication.

routes.name: Infrastructure / platform leadership
routes.name_ja: インフラ／プラットフォームのリーダー
routes.about: Own dependable infrastructure/platform capability, reliability, economics, teams and user adoption.

phases.name: Orient and assess
phases.name_ja: 方向を定めて現状を評価する
phases.goal: Select a role and actual target level. Identify existing evidence and unverified critical requirements.

phases.name: Verify shared foundations
phases.name_ja: 共通の基礎を確かめる
phases.goal: Use the foundation modules as checks. Study only what the checks show is missing.

phases.name: Choose and build a specialization
phases.name_ja: 専門を選んで積み上げる
phases.goal: Follow the ordered modules and four milestones for one anchor role.

phases.name: Exercise realistic conditions
phases.goal: Introduce failure, messy inputs, permissions, concurrency, uncertain measurements or hardware limits as the track requires.

phases.name: Demonstrate independent and senior ownership
phases.name_ja: 自立した・シニアとしての責任を示す
phases.goal: Deliver repeatable outcomes and take responsibility for decisions, operation and others' work.

phases.name: Expand scope or change direction
phases.name_ja: 範囲を広げるか方向を変える
phases.goal: Progress within a specialty or add people, portfolio or commercial accountability.
